limitations: Engineering propulsion; no connectome control or neural steering.
Conservative circular footprint and stop-on-contact; no wall sensing.
Static visual legs; no gait, muscle, force or biological speed model.
Precomputed Python simulation; browser time only selects recorded poses.

assumptions.name: Qualitative HS horizontal-motion and DNp15 pathway relevance
Signed encoder and symmetric opposite-direction response
Unit proxy transfer and mean aggregation
0.1 ms grid and exact zero-order-hold updates

conditions.role: Explicit swap of RIGHT_SIDE_MOTION; intentionally equivalent to LEFT_SIDE_MOTION

evidence.scope: Main Results and Fig.1: ipsilateral horizontal motion; DNp15/DNHS1 identity; broader recurrent and electrical context excluded.
Phase24 primary evidence record; qualitative HS/DNHS1 association, not calibrated proxy parameters.

neural.freeze_statement: All parameters selected and serialized before any HS/DNp15 neural execution; no observed response, spikes or movement used. No parameter revisions based on output are permitted.

input.negative: Opposite signed descriptor; equal negative response is a model convention, not measured reverse tuning.
input.population_rule: Each identity receives its own side descriptor, shared across HSN/HSE/HSS as an explicit simplification.
input.positive: Declared positive horizontal-motion component, qualitatively motivated by ipsilateral front-to-back sensitivity; not calibrated retinal velocity.
input.pulse_semantics: Input active for interval boundaries 0 <= n < 200; zero thereafter.

neural.purpose: Identity-resolved propagation through a bounded chemical feedforward motif; no steering or physiological calibration.

selection_rationale.amplitude: Unit signed descriptor fixes model-space input scale, not a response target.
selection_rationale.dt: 0.1 ms uses repository numerical grid convention; dt/tau_source=0.02, dt/tau_target=0.01. Exact hold updates do not require Euler stability retuning.
selection_rationale.kernel: Separate signed leaky proxy model; neither looming sensory model nor DNp01 LIF parameters are inherited.
selection_rationale.scale: Unit coefficient defines target proxy scale, not biological gain or v1 k=1 mV_eq/state.
selection_rationale.source_tau: 5 ms is a standalone exploratory round-number proxy timescale; no LC4/LPLC2 physiological equivalence.
selection_rationale.target_tau: 10 ms is a standalone exploratory smoothing timescale, twice source tau; no DNp01 LIF equivalence.
selection_rationale.timing: 50 ms = five target time constants; 20 ms pulse = two target time constants followed by three time constants of recovery. Observe onset and recovery without threshold targets.

source_model.type_sharing: All six proxy identities share dynamics; no measured individual equality claimed.

transfer.equation: c_i[n] = hs_to_dnp15_proxy_scale*s_i[n]/3; D_j[n] = sum eligible c_i[n]
transfer.name: hs_dnp15_mean_proxy_transfer_v1
transfer.normalization_rationale: A target reads the mean of the declared three channels, independent of contact multiplicity; this is a new circuit-specific observation-free design choice, not inherited v1 aggregation.
transfer.sign: Positive effective proxy coupling convention, not a calibrated monosynaptic sign measurement.

acceptance.A: Analytical signs, zero, mirror, rigid-frame invariance, validity and clipping agree with equations. Numerical comparisons abs<=1e-12 unless exact identities apply; float64 rounding allowance, not biological threshold.
acceptance.B: Descriptor-driven states match unchanged kernels; asymmetric cases have nonzero model differential with declared sign; controls preserve poses and causal old-state ordering. Symmetric common-mode zero differential is a required negative control, not a failure.
acceptance.C: Complete source definitions, pose arrays, provenance, canonical config/result hashes and exact same-environment replay; five canonical payload hashes unchanged.
acceptance.failure: Invalid authority/geometry/timing/hash fails explicitly. A valid no-differential asymmetric outcome is reported as a negative hypothesis result; no tuning.

analytical_expectations: Stationary: exactly zero observation, HS, DNp15 and drive.
Pure positive rotation: right descriptor negative, left positive; negative rotation reverses; independent of landmark depth.
Forward translation in symmetric geometry: both descriptors positive and equal, HS/DNp15 respond bilaterally, differential zero. Backward reverses signs; not necessarily equal magnitude.
Forward translation asymmetric: right descriptor greater than left and positive differential after old-state latency; backward gives negative differential. No arbitrary magnitude threshold.
Right translation symmetric: both world bearings decrease; R descriptor negative, L positive; left motion mirrors it.
Mirror x and heading, swap landmark sides: descriptors and target states swap, differential reverses; this is proxy symmetry, not physiological symmetry.
Readout-disabled/sham: prescribed poses, observations and neural states identical to intact; disabled only changes exposed enabled readout.
Different translations/rotations can share descriptors. Cause is recorded from prescribed pose, not identified from neural output.

coordinates.angle_embedding: theta_rad_model = 2*pi*heading_eq; geometric assumption, not measured yaw

limitations: Engineering geometry, not a calibrated retina or HS receptive field.
Signed proxies are not biological firing rates.
Shadow yaw drive is not physical turning velocity.
No autonomous locomotion, propulsion, collisions, wall sensing, recurrence, electrical coupling, or new scientific scenario API.
Observed steering contribution within the model does not establish biological validity.

clipping.metadata: raw shifts, raw rates, normalized values and per-side clipped flags
clipping.stage: after side basis, before neural kernel

operator.interval_domain: Both heading increment and relative bearing increment strictly less than half a cycle; reject ambiguous increments.
operator.landmark_association: Exactly one named fixed sample per R/L channel; labels persist across rigid coordinate changes. No hemifield switching or biological receptive fields.
operator.shortest_change: atan2(bz*ax-bx*az, bx*ax+bz*az), with b=landmark-before and a=landmark-after
operator.singularity_policy: Reject endpoints or the straight swept translation segment within minimum distance of a landmark; numerical domain exclusion, not body radius.
operator.within_interval_path: Straight translation and linear unwrapped heading; endpoints are prescribed, no motor integration.

pose_recipe.formula: pose[n] = initial + condition_displacement * min(n/200,1); time[n]=n*0.1 ms
pose_recipe.rationale: Tractable small excursions in arbitrary world_eq; .001 heading_eq reuses the existing perturbation scale only as an engineering test, not biology.

observation.question: Can prescribed planar pose changes elicit traceable signed HS/DNp15 states and a shadow-only differential through the unchanged six-route proxy motif?

readout.body_update: NEVER; copy prescribed pose independently of all neural/readout state
readout.disabled_policy: Keep computed drive and proposal; expose enabled_shadow_drive_eq=0, never apply either to pose.

route_intervention.reason: Kernel rejects changed route inventory. Do not pretend readout disconnection is neural-route ablation or modify frozen transfer functions.

stage_a.method: Symbolic fixed-landmark bearing differences and the frozen R=+1,L=-1 bases; not empirical retinal transduction.

observation.timing: Observe completed [n-1,n] at boundary n; neutral observation at n=0; old HS/target states compute outgoing [n,n+1]; final observation recorded but not consumed; final outgoing readout null.

yaw.acceptance: Accept zero, small, opposite-signed or unexpected internally valid outcomes. No retuning after first frozen execution.

analytical_bounds.neutral_behavior: Equal bilateral target states give zero drive and unchanged neutral orientation.
analytical_bounds.proof: Bounded signed descriptors, neutral initial states and exact exponential convex updates keep HS and DNp15 within [-1,1]. Hence |R-L|<=2, |drive|<=2, and sum(dt/H)=1 implies |orientation-initial|<=2 for the finite horizon.

assumptions.name: Proxy activity -> odd linear orientation drive and bilateral symmetry
Unit proxy scale and global horizon-normalized integration
Source time grid and left-boundary/final-boundary convention

claim_limits: Exploratory DNp15-linked model-space orientation, not a measured DNp15 motor command
Not biological yaw, calibrated turn rate, torque or biomechanics
Not navigation, full optomotor behavior or closed-loop course stabilization
Negative proxy/reversal symmetry is a model extension, not measured negative activity

orientation_model.normalization_rationale: One unit held yaw-drive over the entire frozen 50ms horizon contributes one orientation_eq; no biological temporal claim.

yaw.purpose: Downstream open-loop exploratory model-space orientation from frozen Phase25 proxies; no predicted biological yaw.

yaw_mapping.scale_rationale: Unit model-space coordinate normalization; selected without inspecting yaw output or source peak; no physiological magnitude.
yaw_mapping.sign_evidence: Erginkaya2025 Fig7: left perturbation produces rightward drift; right perturbation produces leftward drift. Remaining-side dominance is a qualitative inference, not an isolated graded motor law.
